ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) surface with a contrast ratio heavily skewed towards values below 20% brightness; high-intensity white pixels are restricted to isolated clusters and scattered points.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid dark pigmentation occupies the vast majority of the visible surface area. High-contrast white pixel clusters are mapped specifically to the distal tips of both lobes and distributed in small, irregular spots across the central and trailing margins.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with a visible angle of approximately 55 degrees and a vertical depth extending significantly into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular jaggedness along the continuous boundary; multiple peaks and valleys with varying pixel amplitudes create a heavily serrated topography from the notch to the tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature originating from the median notch, transitioning to an upward and outward convex sweep terminating in pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast circular clusters of white pixels concentrated at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes; additional sparse white spots detected across the main dark surface area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular serration along the trailing edge indicates significant cumulative material loss. Dense white texture at the lobe extremities represents substantial external colonization or surface scarring.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced upward vertical sweep of the lobes relative to the waterline, ending in highly pointed tips with distinct white-on-black contrast.
